name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 55 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2026-01-19, at wavelengths from 1.67 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
